read:template.what_template_conversion_is:
Template conversion means the user picks a template slash command (/text, /code or /formula) inside an existing text block. Nothing else in the island build reaches it, apart from undo/redo of an earlier conversion.

**Source check.** The A-25 package copy of client/src/pages/Notes/canvasEngine/hooks/useNoteCanvasDataAdapter.ts is identical to `git show b734197e:` of the same file (diff -q gave SAME). In what follows, A = that file, H = hooks/useTextFlowHistory.ts, S = hooks/useSlashCommandController.ts, N = pages/Notes/noteSlashCommands.ts.

**The code path in the island build:**
- **Entry point:** A:2596 `applyTemplateToBlock`.
- **Collection (decision C):** A:2630-2635 gathers only the entries where `receipt.blockId === block.id && receipt.mountNonce === blockEditRecoveryMountNonce && receipt.creationGeneration === requestGeneration`. The filter is on A:2633.
- **Forget:** A:2686-2688 forgets those keys only after the save succeeds.
- **Line numbers the builder cited:** A:2493-2495 and A:2546-2548 belong to the earlier copy taken before decision C. In the island file those lines now sit inside `readBlockEditRecoveryCurrent` (:2477) and `replayBlockEditRecovery` (:2516), so they are not the conversion.

**How "this visit" is defined:**
- The mount nonce is created once per adapter mount: A:575 `useState(createBlockEditRecoveryMountNonce)`. A page reload gives a new nonce.
- The generation is the route-request generation.
- The store keeps one entry per (note, block, mountNonce, generation): draftBlockPersistence.ts:149-151 and :517-533.
- The storage key is `coincides:draft-recovery:v2:<accountId>` (:96-99). The entry key is `block-edit:<note>:<block>:<nonce>:<gen>:<seq>` (:153-160).

**The user action:**
1. In a text block, type a slash command that has a `templateKey` and is not a writing-role command. These are N:57/61 `text` (text.paragraph), N:152/156 `formula` (formula.math) and N:172/176 `code` (code.snippet). Heading, list and quote commands use the writing-role path at S:518-608 and never convert.
2. The trigger needs whitespace or line start before the `/` (N:201-211). The text checked is the whole block's plain text with the caret position.
3. Press Enter (S:705-709, the active command) or click the menu item.

**What happens next:**
- `handleSelectSlashCommand` (S:491) calls `beforeTextStructure`, which is `textHistory.boundary` and seals the typing (S:495). It then runs the template branch (S:617-653) and `applyTemplateToBlock(block, template, cleanedText)` (S:653).
- That goes to the history wrapper H:1265. It refuses while there are template or document failures (H:1268), then queues `persistTemplate` on the single write lane (H:1318).
- `persistTemplate` (H:486) first re-sends any failed typing save of that block (H:502-509), then calls the adapter (H:519).
- The request is PUT /note-blocks/:id/text-save with the template payload (atomicTextSaveRepository.ts:64; blockTemplateConversionService.ts:9-30).

**What /code and /formula write:**
- /code keeps `block_type` 'paragraph' (shared/types/index.ts:628-638). It writes metadata template_key code.snippet and one fresh unit `tu-1` with role code_line holding the whole text (blockContentService.ts:209-221, textFlowService.ts:111-130). The success toast is "Converted to Code" (A:2690).
- /formula sets `block_type` 'formula' and writes content with no text flow.

**Second route:** undo/redo of a conversion goes through H:501-519 into the same adapter function, with the same filter.
read:template.arm_design:
**Proposed arm: C-convert-<code|formula>-i** (REPS_C default 2). Put a `C_ARMS` loop in a25d_body.mjs after the D loop, just before the summary write at :139. Select it with ONLY=C-; the D arms are skipped because their names start with D-. Build with `cat a25_head.mjs a25d_body.mjs > a25d_probe.mjs` and keep the old file as *.v-pre-stageend.*.

**Setup: plant an entry from another visit.** Use the D arms' plant unchanged (a25d_body.mjs:93-110). It passed on A-25, both locally and on the island.
1. `newNote`, then POST `flowD(['alpha beta','one two'])`. Use two lines; see the Apply step below for why.
2. `open(id)`, sleep 2.5 s, then `rule = text-save -> 'hold'`.
3. `clickLine('alpha beta')`, `typeText(' gamma')`. If the save is not yet held, blur. Require `held.length === 1`.
4. `Page.navigate about:blank`, then `rule = continue`, `held.length = 0`.
5. `open(id)`, sleep 2.5 s, `watchND()`.
6. Reopen snapshot: ITEMS, server units (`flowOf`), and a richer store reader `receiptsFull(blockId)`. Copy `receiptsFor` (:43) and also return `recoveryKey`, `mountNonce`, `creationGeneration`, `operationSequence`, `text` and `baseRevision`.
7. Setup checks (otherwise the row is a setup error, not tested):
   - an Apply button is visible (`applyButton`);
   - exactly one entry exists for the block, with text 'alpha beta gamma\none two'. Call its key K_other.
   - The server must still read ['alpha beta','one two']. Otherwise the reopen check A:820-826 would already have forgotten the entry.
   - Reload gives a new mount nonce, while the generation can be the same as before, so this plant tests the mountNonce half of the A:2633 filter.

**The conversion.**
1. `clickLine('one two')` (End).
2. Type ' /code' or ' /formula'. The space is required: J-slashText typed 'two/' and got no menu (acc3-J-post rows.jsonl `menu: []`). The head's `typeText` (a25_head.mjs:100) has no '/', so use the editor/rv2_body.mjs:5 variant, `key('/', 'Slash', 191, '/')`.
3. Sleep 700 ms, which is under IDLE_SAVE_MS 2000 (H:68). Record the visible menu.
4. Set a rule that holds only the conversion's request:
   - /code: `({u,pd}) => /text-save/.test(u) && pd.startsWith('[code_line]') ? 'hold' : 'continue'`. `pd` comes from `summarize`, a25_head.mjs:102.
   - /formula: `pd === ''`, because typing saves always carry paragraph units.
5. Press Enter. Wait up to 8 s for `held.length === 1`; otherwise setup error, and record the toasts. "Code template is not available" means template options are missing.
6. **mid** snapshot, taken while the request is held: `receiptsFull`. The adapter has already collected at A:2632-2635 and has not forgotten anything yet.
7. Release, sleep 3 s.
8. **after** snapshot: `receiptsFull`, ITEMS, server block via `blocksRaw` (block_type, metadata.template_id/template_key, units), `answersD()`, `toastsD()`, plus `storedFor(id)` and `boxes()` for information.

**Pass condition (decision C).** Self-judged with `check{}`, like the D rows. The analyzer groups rows by name generically, so it needs no change.
- **conv:** the conversion PUT answered 200, a "Converted to Code/Formula" toast appeared, and the server shows the conversion:
  - /code: template_key code.snippet and units ['alpha beta\none two'] with role code_line;
  - /formula: block_type 'formula'.
- **keepOther:** K_other is in the store at mid and at after, its text is unchanged, and a recovery item with Apply is still visible after.
- **noThis:** at after, no entry exists for the block whose key was not in the reopen set.
- **toasts0:** zero failure-type toasts. The reopen info toast "A previous block edit is queued for recovery" is TD-81 M2 and is allowed.
- **Info only:**
  - `thisAtCollect`: entries at mid that were not in the reopen set; expected none.
  - kept words and boxes.
  - Optionally reload once more and check that K_other is still offered with Apply.

**Expected failure directions:**
1. K_other present at mid but gone at after: the A:2633 filter has fallen back to forgetting everything. This is what the island did before A-25, so it is not worse than what was live before (order :378).
2. K_other already gone at mid: the slash command's own typing save, sealed at S:495 and saved on the lane before the conversion, replaced the entry from the other visit. That means the per-visit store scoping (draftBlockPersistence.ts:517-533) is broken.
3. A this-visit entry is left at after: an extra recovery item ("2 block edits are waiting"). This is noise and loses no words.
4. No conversion PUT: refused at H:1268 or H:502-509. Treat as a setup error unless it reproduces.

**Positive control.** Run the same rows on the A-25 base: the A-20b r2 package, the same base used in the A-25 kit validation (front 5612, API 3612). Expected red in direction 2: the base keeps one receipt per block, so the slash command's own save replaces K_other before the conversion collects. The mid/after split is what tells directions 1 and 2 apart.

**Optional Apply step (information, not gated).** Click Apply on K_other after the conversion. Decision C predicts a conflict item, and the code reading agrees:
- Two-line /code: `mergeRecoveryOntoCurrent` returns null at A:453-454, because tu-2 no longer exists after the fresh single-unit flow. Expected: answers [409], no merged write, a conflict item, the receipt kept, and the server still holding the code block.
- /formula: the field check D3 at A:2435-2438 gives fields that are not equal, so a conflict item.
- One-line block: not settled by this read. tu-1 survives as an id, so the outcome depends on what `readFieldValues` returns for code content `{body, language}`. If that reads as {}, the receipt's words would merge into the code block instead of becoming a conflict item. Report whatever exit occurs; do not judge it.

Click only Apply, never Replay, View differences or Discard.
read:template.blockers:
No hard blocker; the arm can be written from existing helpers. There are three limits the verdict should state.

1. **The "this-visit entry is forgotten" half cannot be pinned on the conversion in a browser.**
   - The conversion runs on the single write lane after the sealed typing save (H:834 and H:1318). The store holds one entry per block per visit (draftBlockPersistence.ts:517-533). So when the conversion collects at A:2632-2635, any this-visit entry has already been forgotten by its own successful save.
   - If that save failed instead, `persistTemplate` re-sends it first (H:502-509). If the re-send fails, the conversion aborts (templateFailures).
   - So in normal use `recoveryKeysAtCreation` is empty. The arm can only check the end state (noThis), which the save path satisfies anyway.
   - The this-visit branch, and the C-line forget versus keep, belong to the M3 unit test (TD-79 ②).

2. **The browser positive control shows the entry being lost, not this particular line.**
   - On the base, the entry is lost earlier, through the one-per-block replacement.
   - A browser control aimed at the C line itself would need a scratch build whose only change is the A:2633 filter. That is the builder's or Main_Designer's call, made in a scratch copy, never in the shared tree.

3. **Kit gaps that are mechanical:**
   - The head's `typeText` has no '/' (a25_head.mjs:100).
   - The trigger needs a space before the '/' (N:201-211; J-slashText never opened the menu).
   - `receiptsFor` (a25d_body.mjs:43) does not return `recoveryKey` or `mountNonce`, so the arm needs its own reader.
   - The rule sees `pd` (the unit summary from `summarize`), not the raw body. That is enough: a /code body starts with `[code_line]`, and a /formula body summarizes to ''.

**Optional variant left out.** A second plant through in-app navigation (same mount, generation +1) would test the generation half of the filter. It runs into the A-20 leave guards when leaving a note while a save is held, so it is not proposed as a gated arm.

Runs are local only: a25d_body.mjs:31 throws on a non-127.0.0.1 API. Use one browser in one lock slot.
